def: to grace, i.e. indue with special honor

occurrences.text: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.
To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
